parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: Version of Femto Application Platform running on this device

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enable or disable the Femto ApplicationPlatform

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Current state of the Femto Application Platform.

parameters.name: MaxNumberOfApplications
parameters.description: Determines how many Femtozone Applications can be supported by the Femto Application Platform simultaneously.

parameters.name: CurrentNumberofApplications
parameters.description: Specifies how many Femtozone Applications are currently communicating with the Femto Application Platform.

object.description: This object defines the data model for the following Femtozone APIs. * Femto Awareness * SMS * MMS * Terminal Location Femto Awareness, SMS, MMS, and Terminal Location APIs are defined in the Release 1 API Specifications of the Service SIG in the Femto Forum (non public document). {{bibref|TR-262|appendix I}} provides the "Theory of Operation" for the usage of this object.
